spans.text: First item on the agenda. Miss Riko, could you explain the situation?

units.rawText: Ahem, things are really dire on Riko's end.
units.displayText: Ahem, things are really dire on Riko's end.

units.rawText: Thanks to Magrasea-wide entropization, loads of trade routes have been sealed off, and even some of the traders' passages have been eroded.

units.rawText: If this keeps up, supplying between sectors will get harder and harder! Traders won't be able to make a living!

spans.text: If this keeps up, supplying between sectors will get harder and harder! Traders won't be able to make a living!

units.rawText: In response, Cyclopes Sector has already dispatched Agents to escort recent trader movements. Beyond that, though, it would be best to secure new logistics routes as well.

units.rawText: Thank you for your cooperation. Next item: Miss Xuannu has brought new intelligence on the Entropics.

spans.text: Thank you for your cooperation. Next item: Miss Xuannu has brought new intelligence on the Entropics.

units.rawText: The Jiutian Sector has an observation report on a high-tier Entropic. It may share similarities with the heat-death Entropic Jiutian once encountered.

units.rawText: I've asked Miss Hannah to compare and organize the detailed data. Please take a look, everyone...

units.rawText: Thank you all for attending today's meeting. I'll organize today's notes and share them with the Professor.
units.displayText: Thank you all for attending today's meeting. I'll organize today's notes and share them with the Professor.

spans.text: Thank you all for attending today's meeting. I'll organize today's notes and share them with the Professor.

units.rawText: Our respective sectors have held off the Entropic invasion for now, but Magrasea as a whole is still in dire straits. What's more, according to the Professor, there's a strong chance the Entropics will attack again before long.

spans.text: Olivia flexed her wrist again and felt control of her body return. But the earlier powerlessness lingered, warning her that this was no illusion.

units.displayText: As soon as Olivia turned the mind system notifications back on, piercing alarms rang out one after another, and yellow error messages filled her entire visual module.

spans.text: Olivia hurriedly dismissed the alarms—just looking at them was enough to overload her mind—and gently rubbed her temples to ease the strain.

units.displayText: Olivia?! Olivia, are you okay?!

units.displayText: The doors of the Administrator Center were forced open, and Monitor104 rushed in in a panic.

units.rawText: I'm fine...
units.displayText: I'm fine...

spans.text: I'm fine...

units.rawText: B-but I just heard...
units.displayText: B-but I just heard...

spans.text: B-but I just heard...

units.displayText: Olivia steadied herself with one hand on the desk and forced a smile at Monitor104.

spans.text: Olivia steadied herself with one hand on the desk and forced a smile at Monitor104.

units.rawText: I just knocked over my coffee cup by accident. More importantly, what brings you here all of a sudden?
units.displayText: I just knocked over my coffee cup by accident. More importantly, what brings you here all of a sudden?

spans.text: I just knocked over my coffee cup by accident. More importantly, what brings you here all of a sudden?

units.rawText: Ah, w-well, Tasha's memorial day is tomorrow. The Monitor-Types asked me to check whether we'll hold the memorial service as usual.
units.displayText: Ah, w-well, Tasha's memorial day is tomorrow. The Monitor-Types asked me to check whether we'll hold the memorial service as usual.

spans.text: Ah, w-well, Tasha's memorial day is tomorrow. The Monitor-Types asked me to check whether we'll hold the memorial service as usual.

units.displayText: Monitor104 stood awkwardly to the side, unable to hide the worry in her eyes. Olivia patted her shoulder to reassure her.

spans.text: Monitor104 stood awkwardly to the side, unable to hide the worry in her eyes. Olivia patted her shoulder to reassure her.

units.rawText: Just excessive memory usage. It's an old problem, don't worry.
units.displayText: Just excessive memory usage. It's an old problem, don't worry.

spans.text: Just excessive memory usage. It's an old problem, don't worry.

units.rawText: Memorial day again already... So much has happened. Time really flies.
units.displayText: Memorial day again already... So much has happened. Time really flies.

spans.text: Memorial day again already... So much has happened. Time really flies.

units.rawText: Let's hold the event as usual.
units.displayText: Let's hold the event as usual.

units.rawText: But Entropic activity has been frequent lately. Even though Cyclopes held off the Entropic invasion before...

spans.text: But Entropic activity has been frequent lately. Even though Cyclopes held off the Entropic invasion before...

units.rawText: Don't worry. The Entropics have been driven back for now, our defense systems have been reinforced, and the border garrison is patrolling closely. We can respond the moment anything moves, so we can easily spare a day for the memorial.
units.displayText: Don't worry. The Entropics have been driven back for now, our defense systems have been reinforced, and the border garrison is patrolling closely. We can respond the moment anything moves, so we can easily spare a day for the memorial.

units.displayText: Three kinds of supplies? Ah... You mean the drinks, food and flowers for the memorial, right?

spans.text: Three kinds of supplies? Ah... You mean the drinks, food and flowers for the memorial, right?

spans.text: The drinks and flowers used to be brought in by traders... Cyclopes only has medical alcohol for simulated treatment and a few flowers...

units.displayText: Olivia patted the Agent's shoulder, trying to comfort the self-blaming child.
